source: docs/43-Pilot授权幂等与父进程身份绑定SDD.md
scope: Focused architecture review of CreatePinnedCaseRoot, ExecutePinnedCleanup, receipt/terminal CAS, cleanup anchor and principal binding against ledger/saga recovery. No implementation or native-platform certification.

findings.detail: The sequence still permits 'unlink/确认初始即absent' followed by a completed cleanup-fs receipt and terminal CAS. Sections 2.2 line 55 and 2.3 line 64 explicitly forbid first-observed absence as successful no-op: the anchor must identify a present object and initial/final both absent is illegal. This leaves two contradictory implementations of the same operation.
findings.required: Remove the initial-absence success branch. For a new execution, require current present identity equal to the immutable creation anchor before persisting initial witness and unlinking. Recovery may accept absence only by referencing the already-durable initial-present witness for this same operation/owner/anchor; it must not replace initial state with a fresh absence observation.
findings.acceptance: Keep the existing missing-before-initial-witness-indeterminate and recovery-after-durable-initial-present-and-unlink tests as distinct cases, asserting no completed receipt/CAS in the first case.

passed_in_reviewed_scope: CreatePinnedCaseRoot accepts operation/owner identifiers rather than caller paths or selectors; Reaper resolves immutable intent, generates selector and records catalog/member identity before receipt acknowledgement.

Create's effect, durable receipt and terminal CAS are explicitly separate saga steps; HTTP success waits for both durable receipt and terminal acknowledgement. CommitOperation verifies immutable receipt fields without pretending external stores participate in the ledger transaction.

Cleanup anchor receipt, source identity and expected object identity are copied into immutable prepared intent from trusted creation records. Missing or cross-principal anchors reject before prepared insertion; administrator status does not implicitly authorize cross-principal cleanup.

Cleanup takes the resource lock before target observation, rechecks executing owner and anchor inside the ledger transaction, and persists the initial witness before unlink. Replacement identity is not adopted as a new expected identity.

Normal cleanup evidence and run compensation evidence are distinct. Reaper-owned immutable recovery journal precedes compensation deletion and prevents later absence from being relabelled as the original business effect.

Run finalization is a separate transaction after per-operation reconciliation, required receipts and containment/cleanup evidence; unresolved operations do not release the lease. Cross-epoch error mapping does not rewrite immutable operation outcomes or return old run-local results.
limitations: Exact requested source hash was verified before review.
No tests, builds, services, remote calls or code/spec edits were performed.
This review does not approve the feasibility or completed implementation of the new SQLite VFS, native Windows/Linux containment, ACL/handle APIs, or full Gateway/Supervisor integration.
No real classroom, model or audio readiness claim.
